what: the nothing-is-decoration ledger: every signal store, WHO consumes it (selftest-verified against the real files), its freshness, its key metric, and its red/green shift since the last run. Plus per-symbol dossiers: everything the system knows about each open position and each leader, in one record. Measures and displays only — changes no behavior.
